delta.description: pair alignment of the Burau boundary pair: 2607.05283v1 (BBB 2026, n=4 faithful, 26pp) vs math/9904100v2 (Bigelow 1999, n=5 not faithful, 8pp). Title negation in 3 edits; sign inversion (faithful 43 vs 13, not faithful 4 vs 10); disjoint witness objects (curve 7/13, disk 160/0, point-pushing 17/0, Brunnian 7/0); Bigelow cited 13x; Birman proposes 1999 and co-authors 2026 (27-year bridge). Faithfulness threshold closes at n <= 4. Method-generality verdict: relation-extraction generalizes across domains, content-verification does not; overlap coefficient as pre-filter gate.

documented_holes: no mathematical verification of either paper: the boundary reading is rigorous about the pair, not a re-derivation of the mathematics
phrase counts are surface proxies; 'disk' usage semantics not disambiguated
middle literature 1999-2026 not probed: the citation graph is sampled only at its endpoints
no_claims: no claim to have checked either proof
no claim that the overlap-coefficient pre-filter (0.2) is calibrated: it is a proposal, not a result
the two PDFs remain local to AEG trials; pins only, no full texts in public repos
